publicReleaseNotes: Lamp 1.8.1 is a patch release for owners on Run Edit Run Managed hosting. Lamp's technical backup and restore (node scripts/export.mjs and node scripts/import.mjs) did not recognise the migration history Run Edit Run keeps in a Managed database (the rer_migrations table): a backup carried that history as if it were page data, a restore into a new Managed installation was refused, and a restore could have overwritten the destination's own history. Lamp 1.8.1 treats that table as installation history: a backup and a restore both check that it lists exactly this release's migrations with their file hashes and refuse otherwise, the backup never carries it, and a restore into a new Managed installation (before its owner signs in) writes your data without touching the new installation's history. A backup made by 1.8.0 from a Managed installation restores too. Any other unknown table still stops a restore. Self-hosted installations are unchanged. No migrations; the checkout pins rer 0.2.63. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/lamp-1.7.0-status-page-1440.png
agentUpdateInstructions: Back up data and owner source first: node scripts/export.mjs --remote with the deployment's --env-file, plus Settings → Export page data. Update the checkout to v1.8.1 and run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (rer 0.2.63 pin, unchanged), then rer deploy with the same environment and input file. There is no migration and no configuration change. On Run Edit Run Managed hosting, back up and restore with node scripts/export.mjs and node scripts/import.mjs as OPERATIONS.md describes; the Managed migration ledger rer_migrations is checked and kept on each installation, never archived or written. Run rer verify and pnpm run validate:release before adopting.
